Applicability: 1 The system must work on the principle of amplification and detect ion of specific nucleic acid sequence of human papilloma virus by Real-time polymerase chain reaction technology. 2 The system must have automated units for high risk HPV genotypi ng assay detection.

3 The system must have CE-IVD/US-FDA approved assay for High Ri sk HPV DNA detection with genotyping of HPV 16 and 18 separate ly along with other high-risk groups in a single platform. 4 The system must be suitable for any liquid based cytology (LBC) s ample/media. The system must be compatible with both clinician collected and self collected samples. 5 HPV result should not be compromised even after 7 to 10 days of LBC sample collection at room temperature or in coolant box. 6 HPV test must be possible with optimal results from at least 1 ml of sample in LBC vial after cytology smear preparation. The syste m must also be flexible to use varied sample volume depending u pon various other assays. 7 Minimal manual interference is preferable. 8 The system must be a fully automated integrated system for mole cular analytical workflow from sample transfer, sample preparatio n, extraction, amplification & detection by real time PCR, result c alculation & result delivery in a compact standalone instrument. Throughput: 9 The system must have on-board sample capacity of atleast 20 sa mples per batch. All batches must be control validated either with control placement in each batch or unique control concept valid f or multiple batches. 10 The throughput capacity of the system with timings must be speci fied. System must have fast turn-around time providing results in less than 4 hours per batch. Installation: 11 Physical Demonstration of quoted model in NABL accredited Lab/ Hospital is mandatory. 12 The requirement for space, floor type and loading, drainage of wa ter, electrical supply and waste disposal must be specified. 13 Voltage, current and fusing requirements must be stated. 14 Suitable UPS with maintenance free battery with minimum 3-hour backup 15 The equipment must be installed by the supplier’s own service en gineer. 16 Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), Perf ormance Qualification (PQ) must be provided.

17 The supplier must be able to provide support in every criteria (IQ, OQ, PQ) if the instrument has to be moved after installation System Operation 18 The supplier must provide full training for equipment operation. 19 Training is required till staff is well-acquainted with operation of s ystem till validation of quality of assay 20 The supplier must document the system features that minimize th e risk of carry-over between samples and provide documentation for the same. 21 All service reports relating to planned and unplanned maintenanc e, and fault rectification must be provided by the supplier. 22 The system must incorporate valid controls/calibrators to monitor the entire process. 23 The system or assay must be calibrated to the clinically validated cut off which indicates true positive or clinically relevant HPV infe ctions without cross reactivity with non-high risk HPV genotypes t o ensure positive results that are clinically meaningful Sensitivity: 24 The sensitivity of the kits should not be compromised by deletions , mutations, and integration events in the HPV genome. 25 The system and assay both must be CE-IVD / US-FDA approved. T he quoted HPV assay must be in the list of WHO Pre-Qualified List of Approved Assays. System Consumables: 26 Working reagents must be supplied ready to use/be simple to pre pare 27 The hidden cost of reagents, chemicals and other material require d but not included with machine or kit, must be provided by the s upplier Collection vials 28 The vials must have a shelf life of at least 9 months from the dat e of manufacture. 29 The supplier must detail the storage requirement for vials Extra requirement

30 The system must provide all necessary equipment like water bat h/Dry bath, centrifuge, vortex, tube sealer, single channel pipette, 8 channel pipette, automated plate washer etc. required for HPV assay if needed for testing. Quality Control 31 The methods for calibrating the system and quality control (QC) p rocedures must be stated. Internal cellular control to verify sampl e adequacy and absence of PCR inhibition must be present. 32 Calibration certificate and report of preventive maintenance must be supplied. Maintenance 33 Uptime 95%, Downtime – 48 hours where spare part is not requir ed. In case the breakdown exceeds 48 hours, the supplier must ar range HPV testing of samples through an NABL accredited laboratory/hospital to ensur e uninterrupted patient testing, the cost of which will be borne by the company/vendor. Software/Hardware Facilities 34 System must be supplied with higher version of software system and compatible UPS for backup or more support. 35 The instrument must be bench top/trolley top/table top/floor mod el,computer-controlled, and designed for analysing High Risk HPV DNA. 36 System must have the facility to store a minimum of 500 test results or atleast 20 GB m emory with provision of recovery/backup of data. User access control with password pro tection is required. 37 External Printer to take a printout of results must be provided. 38 The system should be capable of analyzing the results directly an d give the user ready results to submit to patients. 39 The system must have the feature of linking to LIS for ease of rep orting. Integration of LIS to existing Hospital Information Software must be carried out by Vendor.It should be free of cost. Safety 40 The system must have preventive measures to avoid cross conta mination between the samples. 41 The system must have inbuilt preventive mechanism to avoid cro ss contamination due to aerosol.

42 Equipment maintenance (Inclusive of spares replacement, calibra tion, validation, consumable spares, preventive maintenance, bre akdown calls) must be carried out by vendor at their own cost. 43 The equipment must be new and maintained by the company till t ender duration. 44 The Local Application and Service support are mandatory require ment for any technical queries. 45 Immediate assistance with trouble shooting ‘ON SITE’, with prefer able regional service centre. Response Time: Should not be more than 24 hrs from lodging a breakdown complaint on toll free or by email. Other facilities: General 46 The quoted model must be the latest state of art equipment and must be with end of life not before 10 years from the date of instal lation. Declaration of this by manufacturing company is must. 47 Submission of the technical data sheet along with the brochure as a tender document with reference to the quoted model must be d one. 48 The quoted model must have at least one installation in NABL acc redited Government Hospital/ Private Hospital/Lab across India. 49 National or International publication and data to prove performan ce of the system or technology Waste requirements 50 Solid waste collected in a waste container /Liquid waste will be col lected in the Liquid Waste Container. .
